card.title: I Started the Weirdness
card.instruction: Hide that one casual choice caused the impossible situation while eagerly helping manage each new consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll feed the little demon. You get our curtains out of its mouth.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It appeared when you read that novelty mug aloud.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Those mugs say all sorts. I'll fetch crackers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only eats words. It's chewing the lease.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll swap in the mug and save our deposit. No need to preserve every possible clue.

mechanism: A manages a demon's appetite while concealing the casual reading that summoned it and removing the incriminating mug.
confusable: Unlike only denying causation, A must adapt useful help to each new consequence while protecting the secret.
comparison: Word-food substitution saves a lease and removes a clue, unlike the gravity scene's anchoring and selective incident record.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
